recipe.text: Fresh Core-defense 'BreachSiege' concept distinct from prior artifacts. CONFIG.waves drives escalating waves; enemies spawn on a ring (ringPosition) around an arena Core, get a real Humanoid + collidable HumanoidRootPart + emissive eyes, and chase the nearest player (driveEnemy). A wave clears when every spawned enemy's Humanoid.Died fires (with a reconcile safety pass); VICTORY prints when the final wave clears and the Core turns green. Combat is player-level only (real TakeDamage) with no auto-kill/test hook. All events print with [Siege] for playtest_logs.
